description: Canonical provenance values for tf-research-policy-azure. 'strict' = passes validate_yaml.py --strict-ms-official.

azure-policy-builtin.meaning: Azure/azure-policy built-in policy definition JSON, or 'az policy definition show'

azure-policy-initiative.meaning: Azure/azure-policy built-in policy set definition (regulatory-compliance initiative) JSON

defender-regulatory-compliance.meaning: Microsoft Defender for Cloud regulatoryCompliance* API

mcsb.meaning: Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark (Learn pages / v1 spreadsheet)

microsoft-learn.meaning: A Microsoft Learn docs page, hand-verified; auditor-verifiable via cited URL

manual-human.meaning: Hand-authored by a human reading Microsoft-official source; auditor-verifiable

manual.meaning: Legacy alias for manual-human; prefer the explicit form for new rules

manual-model-synthesised.meaning: Generated by a language model from training-corpus knowledge; not auditor-verifiable
